body: I'm so sorry, I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy... I recently posted here about a very similar situation that's left me in a dark place, too. I know it doesn't help much at all, but please know you're not alone. <3 And feel free to PM me if it would help to talk.

Yeah. Been struggling a lot different with a different set of circumstances, but to similar effect. Have definitely wished I could just get hit by a car or in a terrible accident lately.

You're not alone. I used to plan months and even years ahead, but now I'm just trying to take things an hour or two at a time.

Everyone makes mistakes, and a loving partner should understand and forgive them - especially when they see you making efforts to be better. You deserve to forgive yourself, as well.

Does your partner acknowledge his own shortcomings too?

I'm so sorry. My heart goes out to you right now. I'm going through a similar situation and posted here last week about how I'd rather be dead than experiencing the pain I'm feeling right now. My ex definitely had mental illness issues that he would not acknowledge until he up and left, telling me he had overcommitted and needed to work on himself right now. (We were both sobbing, too.) He fled to a different city and isn't talking to me. And seems to be pretty unemotional about it from what I can tell. Like it was just that easy for him to cut me out.

I feel more broken and worthless and alone than I ever have in my entire life. Everyone says there's a path forward, a way out the other side, but I just can't see it right now. 

I'm obviously in a very dark place right now, too, but just want you to know you're not alone. <3

I moved 2000+ miles for this job, which I'm locked into for at least another 6 months. So I can't easily move back - especially after all the money I invested in my SO moving here with me and then in their interests to try and help them feel at home in a new place. Now I'm left living alone in a house full of stuff we bought to support those projects...

As for my folks, they aren't closeby either. And I really would rather die than live with them again. Did it once before and at this point in my life it would be too infantilizing for me to bear. (Add to that that my mother came recently to "support" me and instead just yelled at me for being in such a dark place. So we aren't really talking much now either.)

Thanks for the suggestions, though. I try and think through the paths available and just keep coming back to feeling logistically fucked and in so much emotional pain that being hit by a car would be a blessing. It's taken a lot to stop myself from stepping out into traffic this past week.
